what: A white card, trimmed 64px on both sides and rounded at 45px corners, expands into a full-width rectangle (inset 0 · round 0) over ±140px as the card’s top edge passes, then after the card’s bottom edge touches the screen bottom it narrows and rounds again over 300px — tied to scroll on a straight line. Below 750px it is 16 · 24px. While the phone and text rotate sticky inside a long card, it stays fully expanded

options.open: Half-length of the unfolding range (px) — card top edge ± this much, default 140
options.first: When on, unfolds from the top of the document (0) to open — hero card
options.--fx-inset · --fx-round: CSS value before sticking (caller sets it the same as the option)
options.open-narrow · close-narrow: Narrow-screen expand and narrow lengths (px), default .68x of open·close (original phone top of first card 68px ÷ 100px)

use:
…
— Put the shadow panel separately outside the card (original: card-shadow) so the shadow stays in the rounded spot even when the card expands

from.where: index.html hero·Programs·Shop cards — original clipPath: inset(0 64px round 45px) ↔ 0, expand [top − 1.4×first card top, top + 1.4×first card top] (hero [0, 140]), narrow [bottom − screen, +3×first card top]. The R.Remap curve argument is ignored, so it is a straight line
